# config2py

> Simplified reading and writing configurations from various sources and formats


## Pages in this subsection

- [config2py](config2py.html.md): Tools to read and write configurations from various sources and formats
- [config2py.base](config2py.base.html.md): Base for getting configs from various sources and formats
- [config2py.codecs](config2py.codecs.html.md): Extension-based codec registries for configuration file parsing.
- [config2py.errors](config2py.errors.html.md): Error classes for config2py.
- [config2py.s_configparser](config2py.s_configparser.html.md): Data Object Layer for configparser standard lib.
- [config2py.sync_store](config2py.sync_store.html.md): Synchronized key-value stores with automatic persistence.
- [config2py.tools](config2py.tools.html.md): Various tools
- [config2py.util](config2py.util.html.md): Utility functions for config2py.

## Optional

- [Top-level llms.txt](../llms.txt): Complete documentation index.
